name: Viola
source:
Role: Queen
Likes: Conformity
Dislikes: Discord, Miscreants
Alliance: Crescent

Severe and uncompromising, this matron is Crescent's sole ruler. After being widowed, Viola refused to remarry—defying royal protocol—and declared herself Queen Sovereign. She has since made extensive efforts to entrench her reign.

[From the [url=https://www.blissfulberyl.com/empyrealdawn]official website[/url]]
